name: hourly-spline-reconstruction-v1
hours: Every chronological January 2025 hour; all European zones, no hour sampling
parameters: Per hour/technology/zone: one bounded midpoint plus five positive PCHIP price increments at 0/20/40/60/80/100% availability
initializer: Own-January saved supply-knots-lp-v1 proposal; collapse clock features to each actual hourly midpoint; preserve its economic offers exactly
regularization: Mean squared hourly coefficient departure from initializer; mean squared difference of adjacent hourly departures, only where the resource is active in both hours. No month wrap; zero-bid and zero-availability parameters frozen.
optimizer: Full-batch Adam; one update after every hourly price and the actual full-month generation loss has been differentiated
smooth_precision: Refine converged KKT states to primal <=2e-10 GW, stationarity <=2e-9 EUR/MWh, complementarity <=1e-8 kEUR; stricter than existing acceptance gates, to resolve hourly derivatives
selection: Strictly lower full-January original-LP price MAE across the same 41 complete observed-price zones; retain best parameters, stop after three consecutive nonimproving updated iterations. Generation loss participates in gradients but is reported separately for selection tradeoffs.
scope: In-sample inverse reconstruction, not cross-validation, a forecast or identified actual order books. No baseline promotion, explorer change, capacity/network change, reservoir rescheduling or new storage fleet.
